description: This file defines the interface GLAccountWritePlatformService for managing General Ledger accounts, including methods for create, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: GLAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for creating, updating, and deleting General Ledger accounts.

methods.name: createGLAccount
methods.description: Creates a new General Ledger account using the provided command.

methods.name: updateGLAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing General Ledger account identified by glAccountId with the provided command.

methods.name: deleteGLAccount
methods.description: Deletes the General Ledger account identified by glAccountId.
